mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_id, topic, status, start_time, end_time, last_msg_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, topic, status, start_time, end_time, last_msg_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time DESC
